title: nixGL GPU wrap — backend test repair
scope: Static repair plus a nix-free self-check. NIX WAS NOT AVAILABLE IN THIS CONTAINER, so the nix assertions themselves were NOT executed; no image build, driver probe, render or CUDA workload ran.

implemented.two_argument_dispatcher: The test called dispatchGpuBackend with one argument where lib/gpu-backend.nix requires two (backend, toolchainsCudaEnabled). Every call site is now two-argument and the self-check asserts both the declared arity in lib/gpu-backend.nix and the rendered call shape.
implemented.repository_lock: nixpkgs is resolved from this repository flake.lock revision instead of the runner flake registry; the self-check asserts the reference is a locked github revision and that the rendered program pins it and imports this repository lib.
implemented.skip_semantics: Exit 77 is retained only when nix is genuinely absent, and the skip message now states precisely which assertions were NOT executed and why. With nix present, a failed assertion FAILS rather than skips.
implemented.self_check_fix: The registry-reference guard grepped its own source for the literal it was searching for and so failed on itself. The needle is now assembled from fragments; the guard reports the real state.

limitations: The nix evaluation path is UNVERIFIED here. The graphics-configuration scope question (GLX/EGL/Vulkan defaults now set by the wrapper, beyond this record CUDA-only scope) is not resolved, and no sidecar or headset inherits acceptance from a main-image result.
